U01_DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS.purpose: Extract objective, raw structural text and verify disclosure completeness from primary source filings.

U02_PARTIES_ENTITIES.purpose: Isolate exact legal entity names, target corporate shells, and parent jurisdictions.

U03_TRANSACTION_STRUCTURE.purpose: Map out the specific corporate action sub-type and technical transaction path.

U04_CONSIDERATION_ANALYSIS.purpose: Parse the specific payout metrics, token definitions, or share exchange configurations.

U05_TIMELINE_MILESTONES.purpose: Construct the strict temporal bounding boxes and key corporate dead-lines.

U06_REGULATORY.purpose: Track global competition hurdles, antitrust cooling periods, and national security blocks.

U07_RISK_CONDITIONS.purpose: Identify Material Adverse Change (MAC) exceptions and explicit closing preconditions.

U08_GOVERNANCE.purpose: Parse required voting supermajorities, board split records, and fairness opinions.

U09_INSTRUMENT_MAPPING.purpose: Map the specific C-Corp shares, ADR classes, or tracking stock units impacted.

U10_EVIDENCE_VALIDATION.purpose: Audit cross-filing compliance and assign source text verification scores.

F01_FINANCING.purpose: Audit deal funding parameters, debt syndication commitments, or bridge facility constraints.

F02_TAX.purpose: Track corporate capital gain treatments, withholding rates, and cross-border tax status.

F03_VALUATION.purpose: Evaluate premium parameters, target enterprise ratios, and fairness assessment spreads.

F04_CAPITAL_STRUCTURE.purpose: Map out current target share counts, dilutive warrants, and outstanding convertible debt stacks.

F05_ACCOUNTING.purpose: Extract amortization, restructuring allocations, and post-combination balance sheet write-ups.

F06_CASH_FLOW.purpose: Calculate burn rates, terminal dividend flows, and liquidating cash pool stubs.

F07_IRR_SPREAD.purpose: Track dynamic transaction spreads and calculate annualized net yield rates.

F08_FX.purpose: Isolate multi-currency conversion thresholds, cross-border pegging risks, and payment day collars.

F09_DISTRIBUTION_MECHANICS.purpose: Map out physical disbursement channels, proration scaling rules, and transfer agent routing.

F10_LIQUIDATION_WATERFALL.purpose: Determine payout priorities across senior debt, preferred classes, and common equity stacks.

A01_OPTIONS_TELEMETRY.purpose: Analyze implied volatility crushes, strike skew metrics, and premium decay options profiles.

A02_SHORT_INTEREST.purpose: Track short volumes, open short allocations, and target short squeeze indicators.

A03_SECURITIES_LENDING.purpose: Monitor inventory levels, institutional borrow rates, and short squeeze thresholds.

A04_OWNERSHIP.purpose: Evaluate arbitrage fund positioning, tracking index blocks, and insider holding concentrations.

A05_PEER_TRANSACTIONS.purpose: Query previous sector historical timelines to compute benchmark transaction duration.

A06_COMPETING_BID_PROBABILITY.purpose: Analyze premium size, topping fee ratios, and inter-bidder hostility variables.

A07_INSIDER_BEHAVIOUR.purpose: Monitor executive Form 4 distributions, blackout exceptions, and management open market transactions.

A08_ARBITRAGE_DYNAMICS.purpose: Identify cross-exchange parity spreads, index tracking frictions, and tracking basket imbalances.

A09_EVENT_QUALITY_SCORE.purpose: Synthesize structural components to rank absolute closing probabilities vs failure risks.

A10_MARKET_MICROSTRUCTURE.purpose: Track depth-of-book order books, trade imbalance loops, and odd-lot flow metrics.
